changelog:
Version 3.1 — Controller Pagination

  • Added pagination to the controller queue table (default 50 per page)
  • Per-page selector: 25 / 50 / 100 / 200 / All
  • Smart page navigation: « First, ‹ Prev, page numbers with ellipsis, Next ›, Last »
  • 'Showing 1–50 of 234 vehicles' indicator
  • Auto-refresh preserves the active page
  • Filter changes and bulk import jump to page 1
  • Position numbers reflect true queue order across pages
  • Mobile-responsive pagination bar

Version 3.0 — Initial Release

  • Full queue management with Normal, VIP, and Waiting queues
  • Government 7-tier priority ordering (ሙሉ/ጎዶሎ parity)
  • Per-controller private fuel quotas in Liters
  • Driver map with station directions
  • Forgot password flow with email verification
  • Self-hosted auto-update system
